definition.name: Place Rooms And Separators
definition.description: Add 4 room separation lines on Basement 2 (ramp south side, NE stair corner, corridor south side, void west side) and place 30 rooms (Parking, plant rooms, stairs, lifts, ramp etc.) at the JSON seed points, upper limit Basement 1, numbered B2-01 to B2-30; any room that does not enclose is deleted again and reported.
